title: Air Time
summary: Place the landing ramp and cut the nitro for a stunt rider, using the standard integrals for tan⁻¹, sin⁻¹ and log forms.
subject: mathematics
ncertRef: Section 7.4, Integrals of Some Particular Functions
concepts: Completing the square in the denominator
Definite integrals of the standard forms
learningOutcome: The student can integrate the standard forms in tan⁻¹, sin⁻¹ and log, complete the square to reach them, and evaluate the definite integrals exactly.

levels.title: One backflip
levels.adds: Baseline: ∫ dx/(x² + a²) = (1/a) tan⁻¹(x/a), so the spin from the kicker to the ramp is a difference of inverse tangents (Ex 7.4 Q1, Q5).
hints: Take the constant out: ∫ k/(x² + a²) dx = (k/a) tan⁻¹(x/a).
The total spin is F(ramp) − F(kicker).
One backflip is 2π: solve (k/a)(tan⁻¹(q/a) − tan⁻¹(p/a)) = 2π for q.

levels.title: Tight spins
levels.adds: New: ∫ dx/√(a² − x²) = sin⁻¹(x/a); in the boss round take a factor out of the root first, as in √(9 − 25x²) (Ex 7.4 Q4).
hints: sin⁻¹(1/2) = π/6, so the ramp often sits at half of a.
In √(256 − 4x²), take out the 4: it is 2√(64 − x²).

levels.title: Nitro canyon
levels.adds: New: log forms. The nitro multiplies the speed by e^(∫k dx), so ∫ dx/√(x² ± a²) or ∫ dx/(x² − a²) must equal a log (Ex 7.4 Q2, Q6, Q8; Example 8).
hints: ∫ dx/√(x² + a²) = log|x + √(x² + a²)|, and the same with x² − a².
The speed is multiplied by e^(F(q) − F(p)), so F(q) − F(p) must be the log of the factor.
∫ dx/(x² − a²) = (1/2a) log|(x − a)/(x + a)|: do not forget the 1/2a.

levels.title: Complete the square
levels.adds: New: complete the square, x² − 6x + 13 = (x − 3)² + 4, to reach a standard form, then integrate (Ex 7.4 Q10 to Q12, Q14; Example 9).
hints: With t = x − 3 the integral becomes a standard form in t.
Change the limits as well, or put x back before using them.

misconceptions: ∫ dx/(x² + a²) is tan⁻¹(x/a), without the 1/a
∫ dx/√(a² − x²) and ∫ dx/√(x² − a²) are the same kind of answer
Completing the square changes the value of the integral
